Our Story

Built in the Twin Cities, run like it's our own name on the line.

D & D Elite Cleaning & Lawncare was founded to solve a problem nearly every homeowner and property manager in Shakopee runs into: finding one company you can actually trust with the outside and the inside of a property. We started with lawn care, added cleaning and window washing by client request, and built our name one referral at a time.

Today we serve homeowners, property managers, commercial businesses, offices, rental owners, and apartment complexes throughout Shakopee and the Twin Cities Metro — with the same crew standard we started with: show up, do it right, leave it better than we found it.
